kjv: As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table
mine: So Mephibosheth ate at my table
note: The MT reads 'okhel 'al-shulchani ("eats at my table") in the narrator's voice, which is awkward. The KJV adds "said the king", and the Septuagint reads "David's table". I kept the MT's wording.
